limitations: Portable typed calls; excludes XLL export, Excel host, COM and UI costs.

dependent_identity.scope: Inline public physical-settings validation only; both actual production dependents rebuilt with accepted compiler/configuration and identical objects. Accepted archives/module remain immutable.

sampling_method: For each case and side, run 10 trial repetitions, then use ceil(100000000*10/trial_elapsed_ns). Two rounds of ten pairs alternate base/head ordering by (round_index+pair_index)%2. Require each observed loop >=25000000 ns; report per-round minima.
